description:
PROBLEM
The branch regressed the lib suite. Base a705cec2 = 936 passed / 0 failed; HEAD = 926 / 8 failed, deterministic across two runs. All 8 are native LowerNativeProgram Fatals:
- compiler2_native_program_carries_published_callable_boundary_targets_into_closure_calls
- compiler2_native_program_adapts_delivered_calls_from_callee_return_lanes
- compiler2_native_program_does_not_fabricate_nil_for_zero_width_resume_payloads
- compiler2_native_program_jit_adapts_callable_raw_returns_back_to_value_refs
- compiler2_native_program_jit_runs_enum_map_reduce_with_direct_closure_targets
- compiler2_native_program_matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi
- compiler2_native_program_resource_fixture_shapes_callable_boundaries_explicitly
- escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation_at_the_grounded_boundary_surface
They fail via assert_resolved (drive_test.rs:10148) with Fatal { job: LowerNativeProgram(RootId(0)) } on callable-boundary / Enum.take fixtures. This is NOT fz-f98.14 (that is a schedule-dependent slow drive; base was green and these are deterministic Fatals).

GOAL (depends on the native cutover landing)
All 8 tests green. Add the regression guard that would have caught this: strengthen assert_no_legacy_planner_or_type_infer (compiler2_test.rs:286) -- or add a sibling assertion -- so JIT/AOT runs also forbid the compiler2 legacy ladder (SealSemanticClosure, DeriveTransportPlan, DeriveExecutableTransport, root_executable_frontier), not just the pre-compiler2 fz.type_infer / fz.planner.

SIGNAL
cargo test --lib compiler2 = 0 failed. A JIT/AOT regression test asserts zero legacy-ladder job fires.

comments.text:
DIAGNOSIS (investigated under fz-go4.18.3; no fix committed — root cause is in the convergence core, too risky for a single schedule-lucky commit; coordinator independently corroborated the key evidence).

ROOT CAUSE
All 8 failures share one defect: the pull transport projection assigns a zero-width (Nothing) shape to a tuple FIELD of a destination-passing (ExecutableNeed::TupleFields) executable's delivered return, where the green base a705cec2 assigned a real lane. Native then tries to materialize that absent field as a real call argument and fatals (or the structural zero-width-continuation assertion fails).

EVIDENCE
- Exact fatal (jit_runs_enum_map_reduce_with_direct_closure_targets): "native attempted to materialize absent value as runtime value with ty Some(Ty(21)) in Continuation { owner: FnId(14), index: 2 }". Backtrace: materialize_native_value <- encode_runtime_value_for_position <- native_direct_call_target_and_args.
- The absent value is field 1 of ResumePayload{ FunctionId(123) input [Ty(103),Ty(21),Ty(123)], need: TupleFields(2), callsite:0, entry:2 }. BackendProgram records this position as Tuple([ShapeId(12), ShapeId(15)]) where ShapeId(15) is Nothing; the need:Value sibling of the same function correctly records Tuple([12,12]).
- resume_shape -> project_callsite_return projects the resume from the CALLER's local value-demand on the resumed value. Instrumented, that demand OSCILLATES between TupleFields([Whole, Ignore]) and TupleFields([Whole, Whole]) (185 occurrences each across per-component re-solves). When the field demand is Ignore, project_source (transport.rs ~3512) returns Nothing for that field.
- Base comparison: instrumented the identical decode path at a705cec2; the test PASSES there and this ResumePayload is never decoded as Nothing.
- Persistence: the BackendProgram is rebuilt as facts settle; the position shape is recorded during a solve where the field demand is still Ignore, and when the value demand later grows to Whole, the already-produced TransportShape/BackendProgram products keyed on this position are NOT re-invalidated (record_return_demand / invalidate_demand_derived_products in pull.rs ~522/619 cover return-demand dependents, but VALUE-demand growth does not invalidate dependent transport-shape products). Stale zero-width field persists. Same family as fz-bfh.5 transport monotone / fz-f98 convergence.
- escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation_at_the_grounded_boundary_surface passes in isolation but fails in the full run = schedule-dependent = corroborates the demand oscillation.

DESIGN TENSION
project_one_executable (transport.rs ~1986-2006) splits resume handling: is_ignore resumes union with the callee's ExecutableReturn (physical ABI), but DEMANDED resumes re-project from the caller's value-demand "to settle direct vs first-class callable transport from the caller's use." That re-projection under-demands the field. Principled fix: a delivered payload's structural shape must equal the callee's actual return ABI (a TupleFields callee physically delivers all fields) while still letting the caller's demand drive callable-boundary selection — but callable-boundary selection is exactly what the other 7 tests exercise, so it cannot be changed blindly. Also close the invalidation gap so growing value/return demands re-invalidate dependent TransportShape/BackendProgram products. Fix must PROVE monotone convergence, not pass once.

KEY FILES
- src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs: project_one_executable resume branch (~1970-2006), resume_shape (~5118), project_callsite_return (~4055), project_source is-ignore short-circuit (~3512).
- src/compiler2/pull.rs: record_return_demand / invalidate_demand_derived_products (~522/619), runtime_demand_dependents graph.
- consumer src/compiler2/jobs/native.rs: decode_runtime_value_for_position (~2270), materialize_native_value_with_boundary (~3224).

MAPPING OF THE 8
- jit_runs_enum_map_reduce / does_not_fabricate_nil_for_zero_width_resume_payloads: directly the zero-width tuple-field resume payload.
- matches_tuple_field_call_continuations_to_the_callee_return_abi: expects 1 tuple-field continuation (extra_params:2), gets 0 — field collapses to Nothing so the 2-field continuation ABI is never formed.
- carries_published / adapts_delivered / jit_adapts_callable_raw_returns / resource_fixture_shapes: LowerNativeProgram fatal / materialize_call_edges "product materialization should use settled semantic facts: FatalError" (artifact.rs ~124) on the same callable-boundary fixtures, upstream of the absent-value path.
- escaping_destructor_keys_its_activation: only fails in the full run (schedule-dependent demand oscillation).

NOTE ON THE GUARD HALF
The JIT/AOT legacy-ladder regression guard this ticket also asked for is already substantially delivered by fz-go4.18.2 (compiler2_native_front_doors_do_not_drive_the_legacy_seal_transport_ladder + fires_matching). Remaining: optionally strengthen assert_no_legacy_planner_or_type_infer; rides along with the fix commit.

title: Re-green 8 native LowerNativeProgram tests and add a JIT/AOT legacy-ladder guard
